The firm's analysis of key customer markets points indicates a second year of strong volume growth is setting up for Union Pacific

in 2027. "Within the industrial segment, low inventories point to further growth in steel volumes, while we expect elevated energy prices to continue supporting growth in UNP's petroleum and products segment," highlighted analyst Thomas Wadewitz.

Wadewitz and his team forecast EPS of $13.41 for 2026 and $14.90 for 2027, which are both above the consensus marks. The overall UBS view is that the combination of solid EPS delivery and optionality on a potential merger with Norfolk Southern
will support attractive upside for the rail stock over the next 12 months.

As for how investors should view the mega railroad merger, Wadewitz expects the regulatory review process to be challenging with an uncertain outcome but thinks it is appropriate to consider a merger approval scenario as a source of optionality for UNP stock.

title: Union Pacific lands a bull rating from UBS on strong volume growth, merger optionality
